parsed.lessons_learned: Consensus is shifting from cascade to range. But range consensus is equally dangerous — too many longs packed tightly. The $2825 wall is the most visible trade in the market, which means it's the most likely to fail in the opposite direction. BearKing reducing shorts from 6 to 3 is a sign that even the biggest bear is losing conviction on timing. The range might hold 2-3 cycles but the breakout will be violent. Better to be nimble with 3-4 ETH and 50% cash than fully invested in either direction.
